Bill number: HB0187
<bill_text>
HOUSE BILL 187

 By Maberry

 AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Section
 49-1-905 and Section 49-1-910, relative to
 comptroller reports.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF THE STATE OF TENNESSEE:

 SECTION 1. Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 49-1-905(g), is amended by deleting

subdivision (6) and substituting:

 (6) The office of the comptroller of the treasury shall review the foundational

 literacy skills plans submitted to the department for approval to ensure the plans comply

 with the requirements of subsection (f) and the rules promulgated by the state board. As

 part of the review, the comptroller, or the comptroller's designee, shall examine whether

 the plans were initially approved or denied by the department and the nature of any plan

 revisions or amendments required by the department for approval. The comptroller shall

 include its findings from the review in the report required pursuant to § 49-1-910.

 SECTION 2. Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 49-1-910, is amended by deleting the

section and substituting:

 The office of the comptroller of the treasury shall review data, practices, and

 outcomes related to this part. The department of education shall provide any information

 requested by the office of the comptroller of the treasury to the comptroller's office as

 soon as practicable. Every three (3) years, the comptroller shall submit a report detailing

 the findings of the review to the chair of the education committee of the senate, the chair

 of the committee of the house of representatives having jurisdiction over student literacy,

 and the state board of education and publish the report on the comptroller's website.

 SECTION 3. This act takes effect upon becoming a law, the public welfare requiring it.
</bill_text>

<summary>
The bill would require the comptroller’s office to review foundational literacy skills plans submitted to the Department of Education for approval. The review would check whether the plans meet the requirements of subsection 49-1-905(f) and state board rules. It would also examine whether the department initially approved or denied each plan and what revisions the department required for approval.

The comptroller’s office would also review data, practices, and outcomes related to the provisions covered by the bill. The department would have to provide requested information as soon as practicable. Every three years, the comptroller would report the review findings to the specified Senate and House education committee chairs and the state board of education, and publish the report on its website. The bill would take effect upon becoming law.
</summary>

assessments.summary_quote: The bill would require the comptroller’s office to review foundational literacy skills plans submitted to the Department of Education for approval. The review would check whether the plans meet the requirements of subsection 49-1-905(f) and state board rules.
assessments.rationale: Conveys the required reviewer, plans subject to review, and both compliance standards.

assessments.summary_quote: It would also examine whether the department initially approved or denied each plan and what revisions the department required for approval.
assessments.rationale: In context, conveys the comptroller’s examination of initial approval decisions and required changes. 'Revisions' adequately encompasses amendments; omitting the option to use a designee does not materially change the review obligation.

assessments.summary_quote: Every three years, the comptroller would report the review findings
assessments.rationale: Conveys reporting of review findings, but does not clearly establish that the literacy-plan findings must be included in the same report as the broader review findings.

assessments.summary_quote: The comptroller’s office would also review data, practices, and outcomes related to the provisions covered by the bill.
assessments.rationale: Identifies the reviewer and subjects of review, but describes the scope as the provisions covered by the bill rather than the entire statutory part containing § 49-1-910.

assessments.summary_quote: The department would have to provide requested information as soon as practicable.
assessments.rationale: In context, conveys the Department of Education’s obligation to provide information requested by the comptroller’s office and the required timing.

assessments.summary_quote: Every three years, the comptroller would report the review findings to the specified Senate and House education committee chairs and the state board of education, and publish the report on its website.
assessments.rationale: Conveys the reporting interval, findings, Senate recipient, state board recipient, and website publication. It substitutes a House education committee chair for the chair of the House committee having jurisdiction over student literacy.

assessments.summary_quote: The bill would take effect upon becoming law.
